stories.headline: Inflation fears on the rise as one-year outlook in Fed survey hits highest level since May 2023
stories.summary: The Survey of Consumer Expectations indicated that the median outlook for inflation over the next 12 months rose to 3.9%.

stories.headline: Inflation on many everyday items was entirely due to tariffs, NY Fed says
stories.summary: Tariffs added 2.9 percentage points to inflation in 67 categories of goods by February 2026, researchers at the New York Federal Reserve found.

stories.headline: India’s central bank hikes rates for the first time since 2023 as inflation risks build
stories.summary: HSBC and Goldman Sachs expect the RBI to raise interest rates in December as well.
